crossRefs.note: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.
Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and Yahweh caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and…
and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the…
the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside…
Was Yahweh displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode…
You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.

translations.web: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
translations.bsb: The waters saw You, O God; the waters saw You and swirled; even the depths were shaken.
translations.kjv: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
translations.asv: The waters saw thee, O God; The waters saw thee, they were afraid: The depths also trembled.
